events.what_it_is: A free interactive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, games, a claw machine and scratch-off prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat treats; games offer chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise while supplies last.
events.caveats: Official rules state no purchase necessary. Treats, game pieces and prizes are subject to availability; on-site game pieces are available through Sept. 19 at 6 PM or while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17, 18 and 19 from noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. The official brand announcement describes the physical pop-up as free and does not publish an advance RSVP requirement.

events.address: Robert F. Wagner Jr. Park, 20 Battery Place, New York, NY 10280
events.what_it_is: Three-night waterfront light-art festival with large-scale installations, projection mapping, DJs and performances at Wagner Park.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission and access to the light-art installations and programmed entertainment are free; food, beverages and merchandise are sold separately.
events.caveats: Admission is free. The organizer directs visitors to register for free tickets; normal outdoor-event capacity and operating conditions still apply. Food and beverages are not included.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 17–19, 7–11 PM nightly at Wagner Park. All ages. Saturday's closing night includes a silent disco according to current event materials.
